g.text: Real GDP growth, per cent. The colour marks the period and the dashed line the average growth of that period, which came to -6.2 per cent in the late Mobutu years, -4.6 per cent during the war and the transition and 5.6 per cent during the reconstruction.
The real cycle, by political period
